Using a mask and snorkel with a mesh-bag containing collect- ing gear is also enjoyable in warmer waters. blocks.text: Concentrating interstitial fauna from the sediment is difficult for two reasons. First, the grain size of the sediment is often larger than the diameter of the specimens and traditional sieving becomes futile. Second, most of the interstitial animals adhere actively to the sand grains. Treatment of samples to obtain inter- stitial fauna therefore includes either relaxation or methods that rely on the animals’ own activity (Giere, 2009).
